# Sutro Biopharma Announces Participation at the 17th Annual World ADC Conference


October 12, 2026 8:00am EDT[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_996741c7e1999057b0225b6a30fcf231/sutrobio/news/2026-10-12_Sutro_Biopharma_Announces_Participation_at_the_236.pdf)


SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Oct. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sutro Biopharma, Inc. (Sutro or the Company) (NASDAQ: STRO), a clinical-stage oncology company pioneering site-specific and novel-format antibody drug conjugates (ADCs), today announced its participation at the 17th Annual World ADC Conference, taking place in San Diego, October 12-15, 2026.


“Sutro's presence at World ADC this year reflects meaningful progress across our pipeline, from a plenary presentation on the early clinical safety and pharmacokinetic profile of STRO-004 to new preclinical insights on STRO-006 and our first wholly-owned dual-payload ADC, STRO-227,” said Hans-Peter Gerber, Ph.D., Sutro's Chief Scientific Officer. “Notably, we look forward to sharing how the design principles that shaped STRO-004, along with our preclinical findings, are translating into its emerging clinical profile. Together, these presentations offer further evidence that our platform has the potential to deliver next-generation ADCs with a wider therapeutic index for complex targets and the ability to overcome resistance to single-payload ADCs.”


**Presentation/Panel Discussion Details:**


- **Next-Generation High DAR TOPO1i x DDRi Dual-Payload ADCs to Improve Efficacy, Overcome Resistance & Enhance Safety**


- Presenter: Krishna Bajjuri, Ph.D.
- Date/Time: October 12, 2026, 12:30PM PT


- **Plenary Session: Unveiling the Early Clinical Safety & PK Profile of STRO-004 to Understand How Enhanced Design & Preclinical Characterization Links to Differentiated ADC Clinical Performance**


- Presenter: Daniel Calarese, Ph.D.
- Date/Time: October 13, 2026, 9:30AM PT


- **Leveraging Novel Payload MoAs & Combinations to Differentiate ADC Mechanisms & Combat Patient Resistance (Discovery Chemistry morning and afternoon sessions)**


- Sutro Participant (Chair): Krishna Bajjuri, Ph.D.
- Date/Time: October 13, 2026, 11:00AM to 4:00PM PT


- **Driving Clinical Success With STRO-006: Breaking Down Insights From PDX Response & Translational Biomarkers**


- Presenter: Alice Yam, Ph.D.
- Date/Time: October 13, 2026, 12:00PM PT


- **Panel: Building the Next Generation of ADC Linkers & Payloads: What do Innovators Need from Development & Manufacturing Partners?**


- Sutro Participant: Alice Yam, Ph.D.
- Date/Time: October 13, 2026, 5:45PM PT


- **Breaking Down Preclinical Characterization of STRO-227 Dual Payload ADC to Evaluate Efficacy & Safety in ADC Resistance Models**


- Presenter: Daniel Calarese, Ph.D.
- Date/Time: October 14, 2026, 2:30PM PT


Following the event, the content will be made available in the Scientific Publications section of Sutro Biopharma’s website at[www.sutrobio.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ErJGymu-ScWA5lB_AeRaYkW2jqPzt8Vm0J9ar3KU08-7P43-IzY0REATe4c72IKJkL7kZy6s9j76xbtInwZ01TuPAI7yLJ_-ireI1ocBnhM=) .


**About Sutro Biopharma**


Sutro Biopharma, Inc. is a clinical-stage biotechnology company advancing a next-generation antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) platform designed to deliver single- and dual-payload ADCs that enable meaningful breakthroughs for patients with cancer. By fully optimizing the antibody, linker, and payload, Sutro’s cell-free platform produces ADCs that are engineered to improve drug exposure, reduce side effects, and expand the range of treatable tumor types. With unique capabilities in dual-payload ADCs, Sutro aims to overcome treatment resistance and redefine what’s possible in cancer therapy. The Company’s pipeline of single- and dual-payload ADCs targets large oncology markets with limited treatment options and significant need for improved therapies.
